memories.content: The council has a short-term-rental ordinance that has passed first reading. The council's internal rules require a second reading before final passage. The council is aware of the approaching August recess starting August 15, 2026. Some members may have scheduling conflicts or differing priorities regarding the ordinance.

The Riverton city council meets regularly. The August recess begins on August 15, 2026. The council has a short-term-rental ordinance that needs a second reading to advance. The council can schedule a special meeting or use a regular meeting before the recess to hold the second reading.
